attributes.board_name: Maine Board of Veterinary Medicine (Office of Professional and Occupational Regulation)

rules.notes: License renews annually (September 30, fee $50) without a CE requirement: the Board's licensing page lists 24 hours of CE for veterinarians (even-year renewals) but none for veterinary technicians, and the Board's CE rule (02-285 ch. 4) is titled «Continuing Professional Education for Veterinarians». The statute lets licenses be renewed by paying the renewal fee.
rules.rule_quote: All licenses expire annually on such date as the commissioner may designate, and may be renewed with the board by payment of the renewal fee as set under section 4863-A.
